document: Men’s rights in family court, I want the government to notice men’s rights in the family court.I want parental Alienation to be made illegal, When family’s break up 9 times out of 10 the women get all rights to children an men get nothing an have to fight for contact.I want to raise awareness an gave men equal opportunity as no parent loves a child more than the other.

Make all sanitary products FREE in the UK/Ireland, I want action taken upon this because it’s an important step to begin the tackle of “period poverty.”

It is unfair for women of all ages to have to pay for items they need for something that is unable to controlled or something we do not want to have., I want this to be taken into consideration because  the average periods lasting from five days to over a week, it can cost up to £8 a month for tampons and pads, and some women struggle to afford the cost.  This is supported by the Children’s charity Plan International who found that 10% of girls in Britain have been unable to afford sanitary products.

With Scotland being the FIRST ever country to make sanitary products free what is stopping us?

Ban the use of whips in horse racing, The Government should ban any and all use of whips in horse racing. Too much misery, pain and suffering has been caused already., A ban on the whip is supported by campaign bodies including Animal Aid, PETA, and Horse Racing Kills.

Allow MPs to participate in parliamentary proceedings and votes remotely, During lockdowns, hybrid and virtual proceedings and voting was implemented to enable MPs to participate in parliamentary proceedings, and vote, remotely. This should be permanently reinstated, particularly in the light of the ongoing public health emergency., There are many legitimate reasons why MPs may be unable to physically attend Parliament, to attend debates and vote. We believe constituents are penalised and their voices silenced by the current system. The House of Commons should update its processes to take advantage of new technology and join the ranks of more progressive countries' parliaments. We believe the current system, as well as endangering public health, is unfair for MPs with disabilities, illness, caring responsibilities, and those not based near London.

Make titles 'Dr', 'Ms', 'Mr' and 'Mx' the only options on official documents, Remove all other titles - including 'Miss’, 'Mrs' and ‘Master’ where they are currently used on official documents - so the only options are 'Dr' for people with a doctorate, 'Ms' for females, 'Mr' for males and 'Mx' for non-binary people. We believe this will make options equal across all genders., Currently we believe the options for titles are not equal because:
 
1. Males under 18 are often given the title 'Master', then 'Mr' when over 18. However this isn't the same for females who are normally given the title 'Miss' until married. Therefore age is often used to define male titles, but marriage for female titles.
 
2. There are no distinct titles to indicate marriage for men or non-binary.
 
3. Females shouldn't have to choose to hide their marital status whilst males do not have to consider this. It's outdated.
 
This is one step in the direction of equality.

Play ‘God Save The Queen’ by The Sex Pistols at the end of the BBC News At Ten, Play ‘God Save The Queen’ by The Sex Pistols at the end of BBC News At Ten every evening., To help everyone feel more patriotic, more pride in are cuntry and encourage everyone to jump about.

Fund an increase to the school meal allowance in line with inflation, The school meal allowance is £2.30 and has been since Universal Infant Free School Meals were introduced in 2014. The costs of food and labour have increased significantly in the past 7 years and companies supplying meals are struggling to cover costs, if this continues they will be forced to fold., Often it is small local businesses that supply school meals and employ local people. They employ parents of primary school children who struggle to find jobs that fit with school times and holidays.

These businesses will be forced to make redundancies or offer fewer choices of meals which would impact many families.

Call for Free Provisions of Period Products to Curb Period Poverty across the UK, Period Poverty UK is calling for legislation to curb period poverty, following Scotlands's example. We believe that public bodies and local authorities should provide free period products in their bathrooms, while schools, colleges and universities should provide a range of products at no cost., The provision of menstrual products is a basic right for every person on their period and public bodies should accommodate this necessity. We are calling on the government to ensure that every woman and girl who needs period products has access to them, so everyone can manage their period safely and with dignity.
It should be mandatory for educational institutions, local authorities and public bodies to provide a range of period products free of charge in their toilets.

Call for an early General Election for 2022, With the expected removal of the Fixed Term Parliament Act 2011, the government could force a general election at whatever time they choose. This gives the opportunity for the government to take its case to the country and give us a say on who governs Britain., The current government has lost its mandate to govern. The last election was won by the Conservative government on the basis of “Getting Brexit Done”. But now that Brexit has happened, the government have used their majority to force through laws that many 2019 voters did not even support. They have also broken many manifesto promises, and therefore this government has no right to govern the country.

Had the 2019 election not taken place, we were due an election in 2022 anyway.

Make 'outing' someone's sexuality and/or gender identity a criminal offence., To make it illegal for people to 'out' someone for their sexual and/or gender identity without the persons' consent. Anyone who does this can be charged with committing a hate crime., For the LGBTQ+ community, being 'outed' for their identity without their consent and before they are ready is deeply upsetting and is a huge invasion of their trust and privacy. In some places across the globe, this is also very dangerous. 'Outing' someone is a horrible thing to do and should be made illegal.

Prevent schools from being able to discriminate against transgender pupils, A school trust running several girls schools has said that it will no longer accept transgender pupils. This is unacceptable and should not be allowed. , In a time when both equality and diversity are being accepted, it is unacceptable that transgender children are made to feel they are not accepted or supported in an education setting.

Recent actions to support women and girls are a great start - but more needs to be done to ensure transgender pupils are not discriminated against by schools.
 
Currently the Equality Act 2010 provides an exception for single-sex schools, which allows them to admit pupils of only one sex. We believe schools should not be entitled to rely on this exception to discriminate against transgender pupils in admissions policies or the provision of education.

Amend the British Museum Act to allow the acceptance of repatriation requests, The Prime Minister recently ruled out discussing the return of the Parthenon Marbles, saying it was a matter for the British Museum. However, in order for the British Museum to be able to accept a request for these artefacts to be repatriated the British Museum Act needs to be amended., The unceremonious removal of these historical sculptures more than 200 years ago has been contentious ever since they were ripped out from the magnificent Parthenon temple in Athens. This selfish act of ‘vandalism’ and disregard for national symbolism was ordered by Lord Elgin at the time. The marbles represent the cultural identity and heritage of millions of Greek people. The British Museum has said it “needs an act of Parliament” to repatriate them. It is time for Britain to finally cooperate.

Let’s show the Greeks and the watching world our British sense of fair play and what Britain is today by making this gesture of goodwill and friendship.

Replace compulsory Religious Education in schools with Sign Language classes, Replacing R.E. with the option of Sign Language would give pupils who have no interest in religious studies a chance to learn a valuable life skill whilst simultaneously improving the quality of life for those in the wider community living with hearing impairment, Religious Education is becoming increasingly irrelevant in our modern secular society and should be the remit of religious organisations and not schools.  R.E., while it does include sections on various religions, is still predominantly Christian-focused.  Pupils come from many different faiths and many come from non-religious households.  R.E. is not useful in further education or our working lives.  It is outdated, practically useless and a waste of valuable teaching time.

A bill to ensure that defecting MP's resign, triggering an automatic byelection, To pass a bill to make defectors to other parties resign, triggering an automatic byelection in their Constituencies., Because at the moment, any MP can just walk across the chamber to another party that their constituents did not want to elect  which flies in the face of democracy!
And if Parliament has time to waste on discussing whether someone had a drink at a socially distanced small wwlcome back to work surprise gathering outside on Crown Estate land not covered by any Covid laws, then they can make time to debate defections!

Demand a By-election for Bury South, Demand a By-election for Bury South as a result in the MP defection to another party., The people who voted for this MP to represent them in Parliament for the Conservatives. Not to defect to another party to which many people have lost all respect for.

Require sanitary products are made available in all public and workplace toilets, I believe that all public or workspace toilets should have free sanitary towels/tampons available for female users. This is an essential toiletry in much the same way as toilet paper is. Anyone operating a public or workplace toilet should be required by law to make sanitary products available., Most women have experienced a time when they have been caught out and have realised they have not anticipated the start of an early bleed (period/menstrual cycle).
 
I believe there is no excuse not to make it easier for women to access sanitary products when these are required, by providing tampons and sanitary towels in public and workplace toilets.

Keep our bus service only bus running from ossett to leeds, Help ossett keep the 117 bus which is the only bus running from ossett to leeds, We want you to help us keep our bus service as its the only bus running from ossett to leeds and we need it so does the elderly too

Require BSL and subtitles for parliamentary, government and political broadcasts, Create a law that requires all parliamentary, government, and party political broadcasts be include BSL and subtitles, regardless if pre-recorded or live. The public can access many council meetings via live streams and parliamentary proceedings via Parliament TV yet deaf people are often excluded., It’s time that all those in politics and government, from political parties to local and national government, made all broadcasts accessible so deaf people can access and play part in our democratic society.

Make it illegal for companies to have different dress codes for men and women, It's still legal in the UK for a company to have different dress codes for men and women. This means, for example, employers can forbid male employers to wear high heels. This is out-dated and sexist. Legislation should be changed so employers cannot have different dress codes for men and women., I want the Government to prevent employers from having different dress codes for men and women because I am a man who likes/prefers to wear women's shoes and I have been told by an employer that I must wear men's shoes.
 
Employers should not be able to require employees to dress or not dress in clothes or shoes associated with a particular gender.

List ‘Class’ as a Protected Characteristic in the UK’s Equality Act (2010)., The belief that people from certain social or economic classes are superior to others is classism. There are policies and practices that organisations use which are classist. Put class on the Equality Act to protect people from classism and hold those who adopt classist practices to account., Classism affects a large percentage of the population; and affects many aspects of our lives: from education and healthcare, to job opportunities and how long we’ll live. Dicrimination can often begin as a result of one’s accent or appearance.Working class people are disadvantaged at many points in their development and throughout their lives. It is morally wrong to maintain these structural barriers and allow classism to continue. Stop Classism Now.

Ban the tethering of horses and ponies on roadside and common land, For animal welfare reasons, we believe the Government should ban the tethering of horses and ponies on roadside and common land, where there is often insufficient shelter and access to food and drink.,

Legally ban the consumption of alcohol in the workplace, In light of recent news events and it currently being up to employers what alcohol policies to have in the workplace, I feel it is time to bring the issue of drinking in the workplace into the 21st century and formally ban alcohol consumption both at work and in all work spaces., The Government has legislated to ban smoking in many workplaces and public spaces in the name of public health.
 
Alcohol consumption has many detrimental effects including diminishing the ability to make decisions and increasing risk-taking behaviour and the list can go on.
 
As with smoking, alcohol has no place in a modern work place environment therefore legislation is needed to formally ban it in all workplace situations. This ban shouldn't affect customers in hospitality settings.

Save the 84 bus route in Hertfordshire, The 84 metroline bus route is a life line for many people such as elderly who need it to get to the shops or people who work late and need it to get home as it can get too dark to walk., The 84 metroline bus route is a life line for many people such as elderly who need it to get to the shops or people who work late and need it to get home as it can get too dark to walk.

Raise the salary band for sterile services technicians & supervisors in England., Increase the salary of NHS sterile services technicians and supervisors to a band 3 and 4., Sterile services technicians and supervisors in Scotland and wales are paid a salary band above England, Currently England employees are paid the same salary as porters. 
Sterile services is a key facility enabling hospitals to operate, working under pressure to meet patients needs while maintaining a very high standard of practice. Employees are under immense pressure as mistakes put patients at risk, also staff handle contaminated instruments which also puts themselves at risk.

Same-sex couples to use adultery as grounds for divorce, Change the legislation and rights for same-sex married couples. They should be able to use adultery (no matter what sex the person is) as grounds/reason for divorce., Opposite-sex couples can use adultery as grounds for divorce but same-sex couples cannot. This shows that this legislation is out-of-date and needs to be reformed to fit modern society. Furthermore, this is one example of how same-sex couples do not have equal rights as opposite-sex couples.

Provide free school meal vouchers to disabled children with authorised absence, A national policy is needed that ensures disabled children, on long term medically authorised absence from school, receive free school meals (FSM) as vouchers. This should ensure disabled children are not at a further substantial disadvantage compared to their peers., It is not fair that families of children with a disability are not eligible to receive free school meal entitlement they would get if their children were able to attend school. Currently the Government has not put in place adjustments to their national policy on FSM entitlement for children at home on medical leave. This lack of FSM provision risks discriminating against those with a disability.

Require schools provide a vegan meal option every day, The School Food Regulations 2014 create requirements for schools to provide portions of certain foods, but do not specifically require schools to provide a vegan option. This should be amended to require schools provide the option of a nutritionally balanced, hot vegan meal on a daily basis., To quote Laura Chepner, Chair of the Vegan Society's Education Network: "The Equality Act 2010 places a duty on educators not to discriminate against vegan children and students. Currently the Government only asks that schools make 'reasonable choices' when deciding whether to cater for vegans in their care. Those who choose not to are discriminating and it is about time that the grey area became black and white. Vegan options in 2022 should not be optional."

Prevent children in care being removed from homes without reasonable notice, Two years ago I got home from my job and was told that I had to leave my care home that day, within the space of just a few hours. I was, and still am, extremely traumatized from this and I'm shocked that the care system is within its right to do this., I understand that in some cases, such as abuse, it is necessary to remove a child from their home instantly. I do not want this to be prevented. I want legislation governing termination of placement in care to be amended, so that where there is no emergency that requires a child to be removed from their home immediately, the local authority has to give at least one week's notice to allow that child to process what is happening to them and determine what to do next.

No more London mayor position, elect someone  from each borough to represent us., Remove London mayor position. Each borough elects a local candidate to represent local people, candidates have meetings together and work out how they best help everyone., No one person should have so much power, each borough electing a local candidate to represent the people, which means people can have more say about what happens in their local area, all boroughs have there own different problems, rid the London mayor position and have borough mayor's working together giving focus to the individual needs of each borough, which should even help with lowering things like crime rate.

Allow Registrations of Death to continue remotely rather than in person, On the expiry of the The Coronavirus Act 2020 next month (March 2022), allow the registrations of death to continue to be done remotely, rather than in person., Prior to Covid-19, registrations of death were required to be registered by the informant in person. During the pandemic this was eased and electronic notification was accepted, allowing those of faith (esp. Muslim & Jewish) groups to process burials of their loved ones in a timely manner, fulfilling the religious rites of their deceased. In addition, the process of Electronic registrations of death allow those without the means to safely travel to the registry office whilst Covid19 still exists.

Make releasing helium balloons and sky lanterns a specific littering offence, These items are mostly non-biodegradable & have been responsible for the deaths of many animals, both wild & domestic, either from ingestion or injuries caused through panic, as well as littering the countryside. Releasing them should be a specific littering offence., I was riding & found a large metallic pink deflated helium balloon stuck on the gate onto the bridleway which stopped my horse in her tracks. I jumped off, led her towards it, untangled it, rolled it up & put it under a stone to be disposed of when I got back praying all the time that it would not blow off as the wind blowing towards so it would have come straight at us, potentially causing my horse to panic & hurt or even kill herself and/or me.
 
People can be fined for littering if they throw away an apple core. How can it be legal for these things be released to pollute the countryside?

Change Female Genital Mutilation (FGM) in law to Female Genital Cutting (FGC), I am a British citizen who survived Female genital cutting back in Somalia. The name Female Genital Mutilation is not a name that all victims and survivors relate to, and in fact being labelling mutilated can contribute to a victim's mental health and insecurities. We aren’t mutilated., I am asking the Government to change the name in legislation from Female Genital Mutilation to Female Genital Cutting, which is how the practice is commonly known around the world. We believe the term mutilation does not help survivors. because of a fear of being seen as mutilated. Too many women and young girls live in silence because of a fear of judgement. We are not mutilated. Mutilation is a bad label.

Change legal age for buying alcohol to 21 and require alcohol to be covered up, We would like the Government to introduce ‘colinsLAW’ by changing the legal minimum age for buying alcohol to 21, and to require retailers to cover up alcohol sold in their stores., We would like the Government to do this because when young at the age of 18, alcohol can cause problems with crime, it can affects children's education, and for addicts who are in recovery we believe it is totally unfair for a recovering addict to go for milk for the cup of tea and all they see is alcohol. This change would surely make a difference. The Government need to listen to us.

Legal requirement that all job adverts include rate of pay/salary, Make it a legal requirement that all and any job advertisements must list the rate of pay/salary for the job advertised. Not a range or estimate, a specific monetary amount., End salary secrecy, prevent time waste applying for positions with unknown rates of pay, and increase competition by requiring employers to list rates of pay/salary.

Mandatory drug testing for everyone working on the parliamentary estate, We would like there to be mandatory drug testing for everyone working on the parliamentary estate, including MPs, peers and staff, to take place weekly or fortnightly.

People who fail a drug test should not be allowed on the parliamentary estate.,

Extend the definition of ‘looked after’ children, The Government should include children placed in accommodation under a local authority’s education functions, including SEN children, within the definition of ‘looked after’ children., Children deserve protection from harm, to be gifted the best start to adulthood. For children in care, entering adulthood is naturally a challenging time. However, for many children in care who haven't acquired 'looked after child' status doors are closed, and accessing help is limited.

Children with Special Educational Needs, accommodated in Children’s Homes through an LA's Education Functions, are not guaranteed 'looked after' status in law. This means they do not have access to an Independent Reviewing Officer, do not have to be visited by a Social Worker, and cannot access most care leaving services.

Continue emergency funding for bus services, Do not stop  emergency funding for bus services at the end of March, extend it further to give more time for people to regain their confidence to use public transport. Concurrently run a campaign to encourage people to use buses, Because if funding is stopped at this time, there is a real danger that services will be reduced or axed. This will impact on many people who are dependant on buses to get to work, do shopping or get to healthcare appointments - including many older people who have stopped driving. It will impact rural areas, and less well off people - and it could increase car use and therefore carbon emissions. More time is needed to encourage people back to public transport.

Legalise Cannabis in the UK, Cannabis has been proven to be less harmful than alcohol and tobacco and yet its still illegal to buy. A large amount of the tax payers money is being wasted on a war thats never going to be won when we could profit and educate people on it instead. Let us at least vote on it.,

We want the Government to tackle the issue of gender inequality of pay in sport., We want the Government to tackle the issue of gender inequality of pay in sport by enforcing the laws and allowing Women and Men to reach the same level of pay in the UK. Currently in Football men earn on average £3 million each year and women earn only up to £18,000 a year., I believe it is unfair and due to the Equality Act 2010 this issue should not exist today
Sign below to show your support of this issue.

Declare carers as workers, entitled to worker's rights including minimum wage., End Carers Allowance, Income Support and UC for carers and replace it with a formal payroll system, defining carers as workers with the same rights as workers, including paying them the living wage., For far too long, carers have been defined in law as not being workers in order to deprive them of having the same rights as their private and public sector counterparts. Parliament has the opportunity to change that by defining them as members of the workforce, remunerating them properly and creating a post-pandemic economic stimulus by doing so.

Substantially raise minimum fostering allowances due to current cost of living, The Government should substantially raise the minimum allowance paid to foster carers. Money is having to be spent out of foster carer's personal money leaving some in financial hardship, while they are trying to care for some of our most vulnerable young people., The foster allowance paid to many foster carers is not high enough to cover all the children's needs and run households. The minimum allowances for people who help these children needs to be looked at & increased.

Prohibit single-sex schools, The Government should amend legislation that allows schools to have admissions policies that discriminate on the basis of sex, to prohibit single-sex schools. There should be a six month transition period, and this should apply to all years., We believe single-sex schools are bad to be in because students don't get experience of interacting with people of the opposite sex. This can hinder people in later life. Separating genders in school should not be allowed.

Legally recognise unpaid carers as workers, Change the definition of 'worker' to include unpaid carers and recognise their homes as valid places of work. Unpaid carers should be entitled to a state pension for their role., On average, an unpaid carer works 41 hours a week. That’s a full time job, with none of the rights, benefits or respect that come with a paid role. Unpaid care saves the NHS an estimated £57 billion each year. Legal recognition is the least they deserve.

Provide free bus passes for all over 60's, Currently, people living in London, Wales and Scotland can obtain a free bus pass at 60 years old, however in the rest of England, you can only obtain one when you are of pension age. , We believe this isn't fair or equitable, so call on the Government to provide free bus passes to all those who are over 60 years old. 

Providing these passes from 60 years old could also be better for the environment as it would encourage more people to use public transport, which could reduce car use.
 
I also wanted to let you know that this would only apply to England as this issue is somewhat devolved and the local authorities in Scotland and Wales would be free to change the age at which you can apply for a bus pass.

Stop schools restricting pupils access to toilet facilities., Stop schools from restricting access toilet facilities, if a child needs to go to the toilet they should be allowed to. Blanket measures like locking toilets during lesson time is impacting all children instead of dealing with the minority who abuse them., Our children should have the right to visit the toilet when needed. Schools are implementing policies that are detrimental to our children's continence and mental health. Despite guidance from both Healthcare organisations and The National Union of Teachers to not restrict toilet access schools are implementing policies that do, such has locking toilets.

Stop schools from banning clothing associated with particular religions, Many schools do not allow students to wear clothing associated with particular religions, such as the 'niqab'. Such ban goes against religious and female rights to expression, and should not be allowed., I would like the Government to make it a policy that ALL religious clothing should be allowed to be worn and institutions should not be allowed to ban religious clothing.

Require sanitary bins be provided in men and women's toilets, I want the Government to require that sanitary bins be provided in all toilets - for men and women - so that everyone has access to facilities to dispose of sanitary waste. Currently sanitary bins are often only provided in women's toilets, and even that is not specifically required in law., I have multiple disabilities and because of some of them I have to wear an incontinence pad. Due to my condition, I may have to change my pad during the day but normally there are no sanitary bins in men's toilets.
 
This means I have to use the disabled toilet, which sometimes can lead to me having to answer questions which can be distressing because I have autism spectrum disorder as well.
 
Requiring sanitary bins in all toilets would ensure that everyone has access to facilities to dispose of sanitary waste.

Pay Carer's Allowance in addition to any other benefits or state pension, I want the Government to recognise the situation of people who are looking after a disabled relative at home, or being looked after, but do not receive Carer's Allowance in full or at all because they receive a state pension or other benefits, or have their other benefits reduced. This is not fair., Unpaid carers save the country a lot of money by providing care at home, and I believe that anyone provides care that makes them eligible for Carer's Allowance should receive the full rate of Carer's Allowance, in addition to any other benefit or state pension they receive, without those other benefits being affected. The person receiving care should also not see their benefits reduced because someone claims Carer's Allowance for caring for them.

Ensure equality in sport, Ensure that governing bodies allow competitors in womens sport are born female. Transgender athletes who identify as women have an advantage due to genetics, To ensure a level playing field in all sport at all levels - as simple as that

Make Eid a public holiday, We ask the Government to make Eid a public holiday, just like Easter and other Religious holidays., We think that by making Eid a public holiday it’ll be fair on all citizens and Muslims will be able to celebrate without having to use annual leave, or miss out on school time.

Make sure the 231 bus between Huddersfield and wakefield doesn't get cancelled, The 231 is only 1 per hour Monday to Friday and 1 ever 2 hours on a Sunday they have also just changed the Saturday to 1 ever 2 hours 
I want to make sure that arriva West Yorkshire are not allowed to cancel theses buses, There are quite a lot of people that really on these buses elderly and disabled they get cancelled on a daily basis and when I have contacted arriva they have said to me we do not give a toss and its just tough look
According to the government guidelines of running a bus service you are not allowed to cancel buses that are only 1 per hour without 10 days notice when I have said this to Arriva they have told me as they are a limited company they don't have to abige by any government rules

Ban LGBT+ Conversion Therapy, The Government must keep its promise to the LGBT+ community and outright ban conversion therapy on all LGBT+ including Trans people, making it illegal for any organisations to be able to put LGBT+ people through this. Show solidarity by promoting safe, humane treatment of their LGBT+ constituency., It is unthinkable that in 2022 Conversion Therapy can still be legal.
It is an abhorrent, shameful, and demeaning.
It can cause severe mental health issues, as well as strengthening an LGBT person's dysphoria.
Conversion Therapy is akin to torture, it is inhumane.
Without this ban, the government, as well as many LGBT members of our society, will have their progress taken back by so many steps, instead of forward.
LGBT people should be protected as much as everyone else already are.

Ensure Trans people are fully protected under any conversion therapy ban, Ensure any ban fully includes trans people and all forms of conversion therapy., It's shameful that the UK intends to deliberately exclude trans people from a ban in contrast to the approach taken by many countries, despite trans people being at a greater risk of experiencing the harmful & degrading practices.

The government's own figures show that trans people are nearly twice as likely to be at risk of experiencing the harmful & degrading practices of conversion therapy. A ban needs to ensure all forms of conversion therapy are banned.

Make trans conversion therapy illegal in the UK, I would like the Government to:
• make running trans conversion therapy in the UK a criminal offence
• forcing trans people to attend conversion therapy a criminal offence
• sending trans people abroad to try to convert them a criminal offence
• protect trans individuals from conversion therapy, Despite all major counselling and psychotherapy bodies in the UK, including the NHS, condemning trans conversion therapy, it is still legal and trans individuals in the UK are still exposed to this psychological and emotional abuse to this day. The very thought of this sickens me, and I would like to see it stopped one day.

Include trans people on the ban on conversion therapy, To include trans people in the protection against conversion therapy, Wether you agree with people being trans or not, everyone deserves to be protected against conversion therapy and the lasting traumatic effects it has on people. Trans people need to be protected in the same way gay people are being protected. No one deserves to be put through the emotional and physically torment of conversion therapy.

Include Transgender and Non-Binary Identities in the Ban on Conversion Therapy., This petition demands that the government bans conversion therapy (CT) for gender identity as well as sexuality to protect anyone that has a gender identity different from that which they were assigned at birth (Transgender or Non-Binary (NB)) from the abuse and torture of the cruel practice., Not banning CT for trans/NB folk will directly lead to their deaths, especially kids/teens.

Victims of CT are 2x more likely to be suicidal. A government study found that trans people are twice as likely to have been victims of it as cisgender people. Trans/NB teens are among the most at risk of becoming suicidal.

A UN expert likened it to torture & it is proven not to work. It comes from pure hatred. Banning it for trans/NB folk will save lives, not take them. Do the right thing. Save lives.

Review and increase the income thresholds for Free School Meals, I would like the Government to review eligibility for free school meals, and increase earning thresholds above which people are not entitled to free school meals.

The cost of living has increased over the years and more so this year, and eligibility for free school meals should reflect this., For many of us the recent cost of living increases mean we are choosing to either eat hot meals or heat our homes.

If the income thresholds for free school meals were increased thousands more children could be entitled to hot school meals.

There are some families on Universal Credit who have had to work more hours when their youngest child reaches 5, to retain their benefits. This will normally mean they no longer qualify for free school meals, due to the current income threshold.
 
The income threshold for free school meals for Universal Credit claimants was set in 2018, and has not been increased since, despite increased minimum wages and cost of living.

Amend the Equality Act so asexuality is an orientation, intersex as a sex., Section 11 of the Equality Act (2010), does not include intersex people which we believe it should.
Section 12 of the Equality Act (2010), does not include asexual people which we believe it should., Being intersex is not equivalent to being male or female, and people who are described this way are completely ignored.

Being asexual is completely legitimate. Relatively few people know that it exists. It being required to be on equality forms would make a significant difference in improving awareness of this.

Ban so-called ‘conversion therapy’ for transgender individuals, The government’s own study shows that ‘conversion therapy’ does not work, and furthermore, individuals who undergo ‘conversion therapy’ have significantly increased odds of self-harming. The government should ensure the safety of transgender people and ban this unethical and harmful practice., The government had plans to ban ‘conversion therapy’ for both sexuality and gender identity. However in the space of a day it cancelled those plans entirely, and then decided to only ban ‘conversion therapy’ relating to sexual orientation, completely ignoring gender identity. This is transphobic and harmful to all people who fit under the transgender umbrella.

This petition aims to bring the government back in line with the promises it made in 2018 and reaffirmed in the Queen’s speech in 2021.

Require schools to have separate toilets for boys and girls, We want the Government to require schools to maintain the provision of girls and boys separate toilets. We believe that having boys and girls use the same toilet deprives students of the privacy they need. This is especially important for girls who have started menstruating.,
Legalise cannabis in the UK, We want the Government to make it legal for people to grow, sell, buy, possess and use cannabis in the UK.,
